companies.descriptionEng: “Banryo-Daum” is a premium functional supplement brand created for pet owners who regard their pets as family. Born from Nongshim’s in-house startup program N-Start, the brand officially launched in 2024, combining the company’s food expertise and advanced technology. Under the philosophy of “One Pet Owner, One Companion Animal,” Banryo-Daum offers scientifically backed nutritional solutions for pets’ health and well-being. All products use functional ingredients certified by the Korean Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) and are designed with complete transparency?clearly disclosing all ingredients, amounts, and origins to ensure consumer trust. Leveraging Nongshim’s extensive research and development in food science, Banryo-Daum enhances both palatability and ease of consumption, maintaining human-grade safety and quality standards for companion animals. The current lineup includes six products for dogs, focusing on health benefits such as joint care (“Joint Support”), eye health (“Clear Eyes”), and digestive health (“Probiotics”), among others. Banryo-Daum aspires to be more than just a supplement?it aims to become a trusted health partner in everyday pet care, reflecting the genuine love of every pet owner. Looking ahead, Banryo-Daum plans to expand into cat supplements and pet treat lines, offering a broader range of products that help pets and their owners live healthier and happier lives together. Sincerity in every moment of companionship ? Banryo-Daum.

companies.name: BUTTERMANDARIN
companies.descriptionEng: Butter Mandarin is a premium solid deodorizer brand born from 20 years of experience in the hospitality industry. After managing spaces used by tens of thousands of guests, we realized that true deodorization is not about masking odors with stronger fragrances, but about removing the source of discomfort itself. Unlike conventional products that rely on heavy scents, Butter Mandarin focuses on absorption and neutralization technology that directly reacts with odor particles in the air. Our goal is to create cleaner, more comfortable spaces without overwhelming artificial fragrances. Our product lineup is designed for different environments and lifestyles. -Commercial Solutions: Air Unit systems and 10L Pro products for hotels, clinics, restrooms, smoking rooms, and other large commercial spaces -Home Solutions: 180g products optimized for bathrooms, dressing rooms, and everyday living spaces -Compact Solutions: 100g POP lineup for cars, closets, shoe cabinets, and personal spaces We prioritize performance over unnecessary decoration, maximizing air contact efficiency for better deodorizing results. Because our products are part of the air people breathe every day, we carefully select gentle and safety-conscious ingredients. “When the air changes, the feeling of the space changes too.” Butter Mandarin goes beyond deodorizing products. We create cleaner, more comfortable spaces where people naturally want to stay longer.

companies.name: C`ELAPET
companies.descriptionEng: EnB Research Co., Ltd. is a specialized dermaceutical company dedicated to the healthy life of companion animals. Since pets have thinner and more sensitive skin layers than humans, EnB Research focuses on the fundamental recovery of the skin barrier beyond simple moisturizing. Our flagship brand, C'ELAPET, features the "MALGAJILSERA" and "IPPEOJILSERA" lines, which are formulated with high-performance ingredients such as salmon-derived Sodium DNA for skin regeneration, Centella Asiatica (Cica) for soothing, and patented components like DERMA-CLERA and Amino Cera 1.5 to strengthen the skin barrier. Our most distinctive innovation is the integrated special silicone brush applicator. This design ensures that active ingredients are delivered directly to the skin through the fur without leaving any residue on the owner's hands, significantly improving both convenience and hygiene. EnB Research's products are officially certified as Veterinary Quasi-drugs, ensuring their safety and efficacy. Our solutions for relieving dryness-induced itching and paw moisturizing have received overwhelming positive feedback from pet owners who prioritize scientific care. Experience EnB Research’s advanced skin and coat care solutions at the MEGAZOO exhibition, and find the perfect scientific answer for your beloved pet’s well-being.

Canibugs Spray is an insect-repellent spray developed for dogs to help protect pets from external pests. It contains icaridin, an active ingredient widely used in human insect-repellent products, and is proven to provide over 95% repellent effectiveness against mosquitoes and ticks. Its convenient spray-type format allows easy application to the coat and body area before going outdoors, making it ideal for walks and outdoor activities. With a light and refreshing feel, it is comfortable for pets to use without burden. Its portable size makes it suitable for daily walks, travel, camping, and various outdoor environments. Backed by Dongkook Pharmaceutical’s healthcare expertise, Canibugs helps pets and pet owners enjoy outdoor activities with greater confidence and peace of mind.

companies.descriptionEng: 48 Years of Oral Care Expertise, Now for Pets Canident is a specialized oral care brand for pets, created based on the technology and expertise of Dongkook Pharmaceutical, which has protected the gum health of Korean consumers for over 48 years. Pets tend to develop tartar faster than humans and are more vulnerable to oral diseases, making consistent dental care essential. Canident Toothpaste helps maintain oral hygiene, reduce bad breath, and manage plaque buildup. It contains enzyme ingredients such as bromelain, dextranase, and lysozyme to help manage plaque and tartar in the mouth. In addition, it contains more than 20 naturally derived ingredients, including propolis and spirulina. Available in two highly palatable flavors?sweet potato and chicken?it allows pet owners to choose according to their pets’ preferences. Its soft gel texture is designed to make brushing more comfortable, even for pets that are not yet familiar with oral care routines. Backed by Dongkook Pharmaceutical’s healthcare expertise, Canident supports healthier lives for companion animals by promoting proper daily oral care habits.

companies.descriptionEng: 56 Years of Skin Care Expertise, Now for Pets Caniskin is a specialized moisturizing care brand for pets, created based on the expertise of Dongkook Pharmaceutical, which has accumulated over 56 years of dermatological science and skincare technology. Since pet skin is thinner than human skin and loses moisture more quickly, regular moisturizing care is essential to protect against dryness and external irritation. Caniskin Cream was developed to moisturize and soothe pets’ skin. It contains a high concentration of 2ntella asiatica extract and madecassoside to help care for dry and sensitive skin, keeping it hydrated and comfortable. In addition, it contains more than 30 naturally derived ingredients that help maintain skin moisture and care for cracked paw pads. Its smooth, non-sticky cream texture absorbs gently into the skin, making it suitable for dry areas such as the skin, paws, and around the nose. The hygienic tube packaging also allows for clean and convenient use. Backed by Dongkook Pharmaceutical’s healthcare expertise, Caniskin supports healthier and more comfortable lives for companion animals through proper daily skin moisturizing care habits.

companies.descriptionEng: DEARSCO is a premium pet grooming and care brand launched by HC COMPANY in 2023. Built on the belief that pets are cherished family members, DEARSCO creates safe, professional-grade products for the delicate skin and coat of pets. Because pets often have more sensitive skin than humans, we apply strict quality standards and carefully select ingredients that help minimize irritation. Every stage of development?from concept planning and ingredient sourcing to manufacturing and testing?is guided by research and careful attention to safety, quality, and usability. Guided by the philosophy of “Healthy Beauty,” DEARSCO offers a total grooming solution that supports both skin health and coat condition. Our product line centers on natural mud and aroma-based formulas developed with pets’ overall well-being in mind. From cleansing and hygiene care to moisture balance and coat maintenance, each product is designed to deliver gentle yet effective daily care. Safety and reliability are at the heart of everything we do. DEARSCO maintains strict quality control standards supported by objective verification data, including domestic and international certifications and test reports. For HC COMPANY, this is not simply a procedure, but a commitment to creating products that pet caregivers can choose with confidence. With honesty, expertise, and vision at its core, HC COMPANY continues to build DEARSCO as a trusted premium brand and to set a sustainable standard in the pet care industry.

companies.descriptionEng: DentalBio originates from over 20 years of oral probiotic research by Kyoritsu Pharmaceutical Co., Japan, and is formulated with the patented strain Streptococcus salivarius K12 optimized for pets. Rather than simply removing tartar, DentalBio focuses on addressing the root cause ? the imbalance of oral bacteria that leads to tartar buildup, bad breath, and inflammation. By restoring a healthy oral microbiome, it helps reduce odor, inflammation, and plaque formation while preventing tartar reformation through consistent intake. Under the philosophy of “Healthy Mouth, Healthy Life,” DentalBio provides scientifically proven and safe ingredients to support pets’ everyday oral health. As of 2023, DentalBio has surpassed 120 million tablets sold in Japan, earning the trust of veterinarians and pet owners alike. More than a simple deodorizer, DentalBio is a complete oral health solution designed to bring a healthy smile to every pet.

companies.name: Dr. Clauder's
companies.descriptionEng: Dr. Clauder’s is a super premium pet food brand founded in Germany in 1957, built on the philosophy of preventive nutrition for healthier and happier lives for pets. Today, the brand is trusted in more than 70 countries across Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and beyond, earning a strong global reputation for quality and reliability. All products are manufactured in Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany, in facilities certified under IFS International Featured Standards, ensuring strict quality control and food safety management. Dr. Clauder’s formulas are developed with high standards, including human-grade ingredients, NON-GMO sourcing, gluten-free and grain-free recipes, and prebiotics for digestive health. Rather than focusing only on palatability, Dr. Clauder’s provides tailored nutritional solutions based on pets’ age, size, activity level, and health condition. Its diverse product portfolio includes formulas for puppies and kittens, adult pets, senior pets, sensitive digestion, weight management, and indoor cats, allowing pet owners to choose the most suitable nutrition for every life stage. In Korea, Dr. Clauder’s is officially imported and distributed, offering premium dog and cat food as well as functional nutrition products. The brand continues to grow as a trusted German premium pet food choice among pet owners seeking both quality and care.

companies.name: FARM&PAW
companies.descriptionEng: FARM&PAW is a premium pet food and oil brand created by a young farmer who directly cultivates Korean sesame and perilla seeds. Rather than simply selling pet products, FARM&PAW is built on the philosophy that “pets deserve ingredients that are safe and trustworthy enough for humans to consume.” From raw material cultivation to processing and product development, every step is carefully managed in-house. Using domestically grown ingredients based on GAP-certified and functional seed cultivation systems, FARM&PAW develops products that balance both palatability and wellness for pets. By reinterpreting the natural nutritional benefits of sesame and perilla in a modern way, the brand is creating a new standard in the premium pet food market. Currently, FARM&PAW is developing premium pet products centered around Korean sesame oil-based pet oils and terrine-style pet food products. Through collaboration with local farms, the brand is also building a sustainable agricultural ecosystem based on mutual growth and shared value. “From the farm to your pet’s table.” FARM&PAW delivers the value of high-quality ingredients and the authenticity of agriculture, creating a brand that both pets and pet owners can trust.

companies.name: Furfresh
companies.descriptionEng: FurFresh was founded on a lifelong love for animals and a deep concern for what they are truly being fed. The journey began when the founder, Emma, first worked at a veterinary clinic at the age of 16, an experience that shaped her understanding of animal health and nutrition. Years later in 2015, after witnessing serious health issues in her own dog caused by highly processed pet food, she began to investigate the pet food industry more closely. What she discovered was a lack of transparency and standards with most pet foods being heavily processed, heat-treated, and filled with ingredients far removed from real, whole food. Emma believed pets deserved better. She set out to create a brand that would offer genuinely fresh minimally processed meals made from human-grade ingredients, sourced from the same supply chain as food for people. FurFresh was created with a clear philosophy: pets deserve real food that looks like real food. No heavy processing, no chemical additives, and no hidden ingredients. Just fresh meat, vegetables, and essential vitamins and minerals, prepared gently to preserve natural nutrition. At its heart, FurFresh is built on love and responsibility. Dogs and cats give unconditional love, and FurFresh believes the best way to return that love is through honest, wholesome food made with care. Today, the brand continues to lead as a pioneer in fresh pet nutrition, committed to improving the health and happiness of pets around the world, one bowl at a time

companies.name: Gaerous
companies.descriptionEng: GAEROUS is a premium pet wellness brand created with the goal of fundamentally improving a dog's skin health, rather than simply cleansing. Noting that a dog's distinctive body odor stems from the oxidation of apocrine sweat glands and sebum, as well as bacterial decomposition, the brand adopted an approach that addresses the root cause rather than merely masking it with fragrance. Utilizing natural illite sourced from Yeongdong, North Chungcheong Province, as a key ingredient, the brand adsorbs and removes impurities and odor-causing substances through a microporous structure, effectively purifying the skin. Simultaneously, through a scientific design that aids in mineral supply and skin barrier restoration, the brand has created a "shampoo that soothes the skin." GAEROUS has recorded a skin irritation index of 0.0 in non-irritation tests and has passed certifications as a veterinary medical device and various safety verifications, ensuring that even dogs with sensitive skin can use it with confidence. By offering solutions for essential skin improvement and deodorization rather than just fragrance, the brand is establishing itself as a nature-based healthcare brand that enhances the quality of life for both pets and their owners.

companies.descriptionEng: Joyden Pet is a premium sterilizing and deodorizing brand developed for pets and the living spaces they share with their families. Based on stabilized chlorine dioxide technology, Joyden Pet helps manage odor and hygiene at the same time, rather than simply covering unpleasant smells with fragrance. It can be used on pet fur, around the skin, bedding, litter areas, pet houses, cat towers, carriers, toys, and indoor spaces. With a concept of non-irritating, alcohol-free, preservative-free, and residue-free care, Joyden Pet is designed with pet safety and daily usability in mind. The product line includes a convenient 500ml spray, a 1L refill pack, and a 20L bulk size for pet shops, grooming salons, animal hospitals, pet hotels, and shelters. Joyden Pet provides a clean, fresh, and reliable care solution for pets and their everyday environment.

We believe dogs can be more refined ? and more beautifully expressive ? than most humans.

companies.descriptionEng: MAXER proposes a new training culture where handlers and dogs can continue training naturally in everyday life. We believe training should feel approachable like a sport ? something enjoyable, engaging, and rewarding for both dog and handler. Through thoughtfully designed equipment that eliminates unnecessary discomfort, MAXER creates an environment where users can focus entirely on training while helping dogs unlock their instincts and full potential through peak performance. Traditional training gear has often been overly technical, designed mainly for professionals, or difficult to access due to limited availability through overseas purchases. MAXER was created to bridge that gap by developing training tools that are intuitive, accessible, and easy for anyone to use. Preserving the original function while improving usability. companies.name: Natural Science
companies.descriptionEng: Natural Science is a brand made using only the finest ingredients that nature has gifted for the health of pets. Its first product, Fisherman, uses animal protein sourced exclusively from salmon and pollock. Fish is well-known as one of the least allergenic ingredients for dogs. In particular, the hydrolyzed salmon protein boasts a low molecular weight of 700 daltons, minimizing the risk of allergic reactions. Traditional medicinal herbs like cordyceps, red ginseng, and ginger are used in appropriate amounts to provide antioxidant benefits and help restore vitality. Additionally, coconut oil and coconut are added to eliminate any fishy odor from the food. The fishy smell is a major factor that can lower the quality of life for pet owners. The greatest strength of our product is the dedication to improving the quality of life for both pets and their owners. Try feeding your pet Fisherman and experience the difference firsthand!

companies.name: NUTROLIN
companies.descriptionEng: Nutrolin® is a premium Finnish pet Omega-3 brand developed through more than 19 years of research and expertise. Developed with the direct participation of Mikko Griinari, a world-renowned lipid expert and PhD in Animal Nutrition from Cornell University, Nutrolin delivers scientifically formulated solutions optimized for pet health based on clinical data and nutritional science. Since 2007, Nutrolin has focused exclusively on the development and production of Omega products for animals. With advanced Finnish technology and strict quality control, the brand has earned long-term trust from veterinarians and pet owners across Finland, Sweden, and Northern Europe. Nutrolin’s greatest strength is its targeted health solutions tailored to pets’ specific needs and life stages. Its specialized product lineup supports skin & coat health, tear stain and allergy care, joint & mobility support, heart & brain health, cat-specific nutrition, and senior pet wellness. Each product is made with carefully selected premium ingredients and Nutrolin’s proprietary oxidation stabilization technology to ensure safety, freshness, and effectiveness. More than just an Omega-3 supplement brand, Nutrolin provides customized nutritional solutions based on pets’ characteristics, age, and health condition. As a trusted premium brand in Europe, Nutrolin is now introducing a new standard of pet health care in Korea and aims to become a reliable health partner for pet owners.

companies.name: PET BOOTH
companies.descriptionEng: PET BOOTH is a self-service pet photography brand created with the belief that pets are not simply subjects of a photo, but the true stars of the experience. Designed for pets and their owners to enjoy special moments together, PET BOOTH combines consideration for pets’ physical characteristics and behavioral traits with natural eye guidance and stable lighting, allowing anyone to capture precious memories easily and comfortably. Its signature “Jelly Shot” captures the adorable paw-pad angle that pet owners most want to see, bringing a unique photography experience once limited to professional studios into everyday spaces. More than just a device for taking pictures, PET BOOTH represents a new form of play culture and experiential content where pets and their owners can interact, have fun, and create meaningful memories together. In addition, the PET BOOTH app expands the offline experience into an online platform. Using data collected through the PET BOOTH machine, such as weight and paw-pad information, the app provides health care services, a variety of content tailored to pet owners who want to connect more deeply with their pets, and linked commerce features. Through this integrated structure, PET BOOTH transforms a simple photo experience into a broader lifestyle platform that continues both offline and online.

companies.name: PETEECO
companies.descriptionEng: Peteeco is dedicated to a sustainable future where people, nature, and companion animals thrive together. Through joint development with a raw-material partner, Peteeco became the first to secure coconut biomass and signed an exclusive supply agreement to ensure a stable feedstock. Derived from coconut shells, this material is BPA-free and free of other harmful substances. A biodegradable additive enables natural decomposition within 60 months after disposal. With more than 30% coconut biomass content, it can replace conventional petroleum-based plastics and silicone, reducing fossil resource use and supporting lower CO2 emissions. Peteeco also owns proprietary, patented technology for a chitin-based material produced by processing discarded exoskeletons of black soldier fly larvae into a PP-based eco-friendly resin. By converting waste into high-performance, sustainable materials, Peteeco delivers differentiated pet products that unite safety, functionality, and environmental responsibility.

companies.name: Pet's mamma
companies.descriptionEng: Petsmamma is a premium handmade pet treat brand dedicated to providing safe and healthy snacks for dogs. Based on its own manufacturing facility, the company manages the entire production process?from sourcing raw ingredients to processing, drying, and packaging?to ensure consistent quality and safety standards comparable to human-grade food. One of the key strengths of Petsmamma lies in its proprietary low-sodium and salt-free processing technology. By carefully removing excess salt from pollack, a commonly used high-protein ingredient, the brand develops products that support dogs’ kidney health while maintaining nutritional balance. This technology allows Petsmamma to differentiate itself in the growing premium pet food market. Its flagship products, including salt-free dried pollack and pollack chips, are produced using a low-temperature drying method that preserves essential nutrients such as protein and amino acids while enhancing crisp texture and palatability. In addition, the brand offers a diverse product lineup including duck, chicken, and salmon-based treats, as well as dental chew products, catering to various dietary needs and preferences. Petsmamma has successfully built a strong customer base through major online platforms such as Naver Smart Store, gaining trust through consistent product quality and positive consumer feedback. The company is also expanding its presence into offline retail channels and exploring partnerships with distributors and retailers

companies.name: Portland pet food
companies.descriptionEng: Portland Pet Food Company (PPFC) was born from a simple home-cooked meal made for a senior poodle named Rosie. After years of extreme pickiness and a prognosis of only six months to live, Rosie finally ate a gently cooked beef and rice recipe prepared by her owner, Katie McCarron. This moment led Katie to question the transparency and quality of conventional “premium” pet foods and to begin developing a better alternative. In 2014, together with her family, Katie started creating human-grade recipes in certified kitchens in Portland, guided by a veterinary nutritionist and the Oregon State University (OSU) Food Innovation Center. What began at local farmers markets quickly grew, earning a place on the shelves of Zupan’s Markets and later expanding nationwide. PPFC became the first brand to offer 100% USA-sourced and made, gently cooked dog meals in preservative-free, shelf-stable, microwaveable pouches. Today, its products are available in over 300 retail locations, including Whole Foods. With its entire supply chain based in the United States, PPFC has maintained consistent quality and supply while being recognized as a Top 20 Sustainable Pet Food Company by the Pet Sustainability Coalition. Still family-owned and operated, PPFC is committed to providing transparent, human-grade nutrition for pets who are truly part of the family.

companies.name: Rebiogen Pet LAB
companies.descriptionEng: We always begin with a question. “Is the current way of caring truly the best?” “Are there signals we may be missing?” Rebiogen Pet Lab is both a research-driven technology team and a group of pet guardians who live with and care for their companions every day. That is why we hold ourselves to the most rigorous standards. By analyzing the microbiome, the internal microbial ecosystem that serves as a key indicator of health, through globally patented technology, we visualize invisible health conditions as objective data. And we do not stop at analysis. Through a three-step mechanism of “Breakdown, Inhibition, and Replenishment,” we have developed functional solutions designed to create meaningful changes for pets. What Rebiogen Pet Lab provides is not simply a product, but scientific evidence that allows guardians to make confident choices.

companies.descriptionEng: ROLLING PEPE is an independent dog fashion brand inspired by vintage American fashion, bringing together classic charm and a touch of playful sweetness. The timeless appeal of vintage style, eye-catching colors, and individuality that shines naturally through everyday life. Rather than following trends, ROLLING PEPE creates new styles through its own unique perspective. From choosing fabrics and combining colors to perfecting the smallest details, every step reflects ROLLING PEPE’s personal taste, care, and dedication. Sometimes sweet, sometimes playful, and sometimes a little more understated. After all, there are no rules when it comes to fashion for our beloved dogs. We hope the clothes we create will be more than just dog apparel, adding something special to the everyday moments we share with our companions. With that simple wish in mind, ROLLING PEPE continues to create, one little outfit at a time.

companies.brandNameKr: Ruffey Gently Air Dried Cat Food
companies.descriptionEng: For our best friends, "good enough" is never enough. At Ruffey, we believe every pet deserves a life of boundless energy powered by a diet that respects their biological roots. Based in Melbourne, Australia, we are a family-owned leader in pet wellness, bridging the gap between ancestral wisdom and clinical precision to create the future of pet nutrition. Our journey led us back to the land. For thousands of years, the Australian Outback has held the secret to perfect preservation through natural air drying. At Ruffey, we’ve brought that ancient wisdom into the modern era. From our state-of-the-art 5,000sqm Melbourne facility, we have traded high-heat ovens for proprietary precision machinery that replicates the gentle, nutrient-dense power of the Outback wind. We lead with high-performance novel proteins like wild Kangaroo and lean Venison, alongside premium Australian staples. By owning the entire process in-house, we lock in the living nutrition and vitamins that industrial cooking destroys, ensuring total quality control from sourcing to the final seal. Every Ruffey meal is 100% human-grade and grain-free, meticulously overseen by our in-house Veterinarians and PhD Animal Nutritionists to exceed PrimeSafe and HACCP standards. We don't just supply food; we power a nutrient-dense evolution designed to fuel the spirit of dogs and cats and help them live their longest, healthiest lives. Ruffey. Born of the land. Refined by science. Engineered for excellence.

The core values that the PESLA brand pursues are four of the following. It also sets a new benchmark for pet products with automatic control, wireless communication, and engineering design that fits your dog's body shape. Here are three key products. 1.Hannes: "Freedom without the lead cord getting stuck in the leg". It does not interfere with your dog's movement, leaving only the joy of walking. 2. Auto-Lock Muzzle: "Automatically keeps you safe, only when needed." Locked only when barking or trying to bite, and free to eat and drink in normal times. 3.Wireless Leash: "A new culture of walking without lead strings." Wireless technology sets a safe range of activities for your dog and supports a freer life of companion.

companies.descriptionEng: At SANKOPET, we believe that life with pets should be full of comfort, happiness, and harmony. As part of the Sanko Group in Japan, we combine decades of manufacturing experience with innovation to create thoughtful, functional pet care products that enhance the everyday lives of pets and their families. Our mission is to provide a safe, clean, and comfortable living environment for pets, with the same care we give to our own homes. Every product is designed and developed in Japan, inspired by real customer feedback and modern lifestyles. From flooring mats that protect both your home and your pet’s joints, to hygienic and stylish living solutions, each item reflects our commitment to quality, practicality, and long-lasting peace of mind. Pets are more than companions?they are family. That’s why we continuously refine materials, test designs, and focus on every detail that makes life safer, more comfortable, and more enjoyable for both pets and their owners. Rooted in Japanese principles of simplicity, durability, and respect for life, SANKOPET products promote harmony between humans, animals, and their shared spaces. SANKOPET is more than a product brand; it represents a way of living?growing together with pets and sharing warm, happy moments every day. Living with your companion, forever.

companies.descriptionEng: SIL Rehab is a veterinary orthopedic medical device brand focused on addressing the growing prevalence of joint disorders in companion animals, particularly in small-breed dogs where conditions such as patellar luxation and hip instability are highly common. The brand provides non-surgical, wearable solutions designed to support joint health, rehabilitation, and long-term mobility. SIL Rehab develops wearable medical devices using low-durometer, medical-grade silicone to deliver targeted compression and joint stabilization. These devices are designed to maintain proper joint alignment, reduce abnormal movement, improve gait stability, and support post-operative recovery, while also helping alleviate chronic pain All products comply with non-invasive Class I veterinary medical device standards and are made with hypoallergenic, highly flexible materials to ensure comfort during extended daily use SIL Rehab collaborates with veterinarians and rehabilitation professionals to create clinically grounded, data-driven solutions, with a long-term vision of integrating AI-based diagnostics into a precision rehabilitation platform for companion animals.

companies.name: TAURO PRO LINE
companies.descriptionEng: Tauro Pro Line is a premium European pet beauty brand offering professional care solutions for the skin and coat health of companion animals. Built on the philosophy of protecting pets’ well-being through the purity of nature, Tauro Pro Line develops specialized products designed to support various skin types, coat conditions, and grooming needs. Originating from Lithuania, Tauro Pro Line has collaborated with veterinarians, breeders, and professional groomers to analyze common skin and coat concerns in pets and create a comprehensive product lineup, including shampoos, masks, conditioners, elixirs, and mists. The brand’s formulas are developed with a clean formulation approach, excluding silicone, parabens, SLS, and artificial colorants. This allows the products to be used safely and effectively, even on pets with sensitive skin. Beyond simple cleansing, Tauro Pro Line offers a structured step-by-step care system and professional spa programs designed to help restore healthy skin balance, improve coat condition, and provide a more customized grooming experience. Today, Tauro Pro Line is loved in more than 60 countries worldwide. With nature-inspired ingredients, professional product development, and a customized spa care system, the brand continues to provide premium solutions that support healthier, more beautiful lives for pets.

companies.name: THANKSMELL
companies.descriptionEng: THANKSMELL, meaning “the thankful scent given by nature,” is a premium pet care brand built on naturally derived ingredients. It was inspired by the real-life experience of a father raising a young child and a companion dog, recognizing the need for a safer and more convenient way to care for pets. The brand proposes a new daily care approach that reduces the need for frequent bathing while maintaining hygiene. The signature product, the “Puppy Shower Spray,” is formulated with phytoncide oil directly extracted from domestic hinoki cypress. It is designed to address both odor control and hygiene care simultaneously, helping create a cleaner and more pleasant living environment. To ensure safety for direct use on pets, a food-grade natural emulsifier is applied. Through a nano-homogenization process, the product is developed as a fine mist spray, allowing even and gentle application across the pet’s coat and skin. Tests conducted by the Korea Analysis Testing Institute confirmed 99.9odorization and 99.9% antibacterial effects. It is also approved as a quasi-drug for animals, making it safe for direct application. With the message “3-second care instead of bathing,” THANKSMELL introduces a new, convenient way of pet care that fits seamlessly into daily life, setting a new direction for pet hygiene management. MADE BY NATURE, THE THANKFUL SMELL

companies.name: Tunalala
companies.descriptionEng: Tunalala is a premium dog treat brand created with one simple goal: to provide safe, trustworthy, and high-quality nutrition for beloved pets. The brand began from a father’s desire to make healthy treats for his own dogs, and has since grown into a brand loved by many pet owners who value clean and honest ingredients. All Tunalala products are made with 100% raw tuna as a single protein source. We do not mix other meats, and strictly follow our principles of no additives, no preservatives, and no artificial coloring. Tuna is naturally low in fat and high in protein, and is rich in Omega-3 fatty acids (EPA & DHA) and iron, which help support overall health, energy, and vitality in dogs. To preserve freshness and nutritional value, we use rapid freezing and careful processing methods, ensuring that the natural taste and benefits of tuna are retained. At Tunalala, we believe that dog treats should be more than just snacks. They should reflect the care, love, and trust that pet owners have for their companions. We are committed to continuously developing premium products that contribute to healthier and happier lives for dogs around the world.

companies.name: VELY&MORE
companies.descriptionEng: # BRAND STORY Making everyday moments more lovely. VELY & MORE was created to make everyday life with pets a little more lovely. The name "VELY" comes from the word "Lovely," reflecting our belief that comfort for pets and satisfaction for their families should naturally go hand in hand. From morning walks and sunny outings to quiet moments spent together at home, we cherish every moment shared between pets and their families, from everyday routines to special occasions. When we first started VELY & MORE, creating lovely and beautiful clothing was our highest priority. However, as we operated our pet select shop and met countless dogs at exhibitions and events, our perspective gradually changed. We realized that while beautiful clothing is important, a dog's comfort and freedom of movement matter even more. Those experiences naturally shaped our standards for fabric selection and pattern-making. At VELY & MORE, we value timeless designs, everyday comfort, and thoughtful pattern-making that allows pets to move naturally and comfortably. Rather than following short-lived trends, we focus on creating pieces that offer lasting comfort, practicality, and natural beauty. A comfortable place for pets. A lovely moment for the people who love them. VELY & MORE is here to make everyday moments more lovely.

companies.descriptionEng: An Unhurried Beginning, Built on Care and Patience We didn’t start making cat litter because we discovered a business opportunity. We started because life with cats deserves more care?and more thoughtfulness. Cats don’t complain. Each day, they quietly return to the same corner, trusting us with their most private moments. What we often give back, however, is compromise? dust in the air, unstable clumps, odors that return again and again. These may seem like small issues, but over time, they affect the ease and comfort of daily life? for both cats and the people who care for them. So we chose to slow down. To take a closer look at this seemingly simple product. Without chasing trends or creating anxiety, we focused on real, everyday use. Are the raw materials truly safe? Is the production process clean and consistent? Can every bag be relied on?quietly and steadily? We believe good cat litter doesn’t need to be loud. It should simply do its job well, helping cats feel at ease and giving people peace of mind, so attention can return to what truly matters: love and companionship.

companies.name: ZOYO
companies.descriptionEng: ZOYO Brand Introduction ZOYO is a lifestyle care brand by HJNL Co., Ltd., offering deodorizing and fragrance products designed to make everyday spaces more pleasant, refreshing, and comfortable. Based on naturally derived and vegan ingredients, ZOYO aims to provide products that can be used with confidence in spaces shared by people and companion animals. Rather than simply masking odors with strong fragrances, ZOYO focuses on reducing unpleasant smells in daily life and naturally improving the atmosphere of any space. Its products can be used in various environments, including homes, bathrooms, cars, offices, and pet living areas. With gentle scents and stylish designs, ZOYO products blend seamlessly into interiors like decorative objects. ZOYO also considers sustainable product development through the use of biodegradable containers and safe ingredients. The brand continues to grow with the goal of bringing small moments of comfort, freshness, and joy to customers’ everyday lives.
